analysis.description: The paper introduces representation mixing for TTS systems, allowing flexible choice between character, phoneme, or mixed input representations during inference. The method enhances pronunciation control which is crucial in TTS and shows improved performance in speech synthesis experiments.

type.justification: The paper includes experiments and user studies to validate the proposed method.
type.quote: Experiments and user studies on a public audiobook corpus show the efficacy of our approach.
